what: PHONE PROBE REPORT EXPORT is unreliable (found 2026-10-05, build 1a.3): (1) the Share button 'did nothing' for the operator; export() reports its outcome only on the status line (REFUSED by the leak check, or 'report shared: N chars'), and the text was not reported, so the cause is undiagnosed (suspects: the leak check refusing, or the share sheet failing on a very large EXTRA_TEXT); (2) the captures list keeps only the last 6, so early captures (the 11:43Z first logged-in capture) roll off; (3) pasting the report into chat truncates it inside the captures list. Fix in the NEXT build made for any other reason (a reinstall wipes the logged-in session under test, so do NOT build only for this): write the report to a file and share the file, show size and result in a dialog, catch and display any share error, and keep every capture (or write each to its own file).
